The '''Thrynka system''' was located in the [[Dohlbani sector/Legends|Dohlbani sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point, the individual [[Jhensara]] acquired a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and traveled to the Thrynka [[Star system/Legends|system]], which she viewed as a promising destination, in order to [[Merchant/Legends|sell]] the contents of the ship's cargo-hold. While in transit, however, Jhensara's vessel approached an [[asteroid storm]]. After the alarm [[Klaxon/Legends|klaxons]] of her starship engaged, Jhensara observed the obstacle ahead and quickly determined that she had not arrived in the Thrynka system.<ref name="Journal7">{{JournalCite|7|The History of R-Series Astromech Droids}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Thrynka system was first mentioned in "[[The History of R-Series Astromech Droids]]," an article authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and published in the [[August]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 7|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 7]].<ref name="Journal7" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square R-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
